title: Accepted equivalences
description: The CANON record of identity across brains (buildout W1.4): equivalence edges a curator has accepted. Each entry becomes a same_as / facet_of / aligns_with edge in the compiled brain, carrying confidence, who asserted it and the evidence. Proposals (app/proposals.json, from aggregate-brains) are NOT canon — an entry moves here only by a deliberate act, and a wrong one is removed, never un-merged, because equivalence is an edge, not a merge.

source.description: Node id (federated form `<repo>/<kind>:<id>` when it lives in another brain).

dismissed.description: Proposal ids the curator rejected. merge-proposals drops a re-emitted proposal whose id is listed here, so rejection is remembered without editing the generated queue.
